purpose: Paper-grade internal systematic mapping and C1 novelty audit for the muKG GPU runtime paper.
official_source_policy: Official documentation, repositories, and preprints may inform discovery but are excluded from the prior-art corpus and cannot support a peer-reviewed novelty verdict.
addendum_gate: If C3 or C4 is promoted to a contribution after Part 4 or Part 5, an X1.5 addendum must be completed before the promotion is propagated.

research_questions.MQ1: What peer-reviewed systems generate, filter, or place GPU negative samples for knowledge-graph embedding training?
research_questions.MQ2: How do peer-reviewed KGE systems integrate sampling with training loops, schedulers, batching, or distributed execution?
research_questions.MQ3: What peer-reviewed cost models, scheduling strategies, or batch-packing mechanisms target KGE runtime variability or throughput?
research_questions.MQ4: What evidence, repetition, uncertainty, and reproducibility practices are reported by comparable KGE runtime systems?
research_questions.NQ1: Does the declared C1 contribution overlap with an existing peer-reviewed mechanism and evidence protocol strongly enough to require retaining, narrowing, reframing, or dropping the novelty claim?

contribution_scope.C1: Hard verdict: auditable GPU-native negative-sampling runtime-path redesign under the frozen muKG protocol.
contribution_scope.C2: Background overlap risk only: implemented two-stage runtime organization and shared Scheduler/BatchProvider boundary.
contribution_scope.C3: Background overlap risk only until Part 4 promotes it.
contribution_scope.C4: Background overlap risk only until Part 5 promotes it.

retrieval.study_family_rule: Formal conference, journal, or extended versions are grouped as one study family while retaining each manifestation as a record.

screening.conflict_policy: Human confirmation is required for conflicts, uncertain boundaries, and direct C1 candidates.
eligibility: Publication year is within the frozen window.
The publication is formally peer reviewed.
The work concerns KGE training, negative sampling, runtime integration, scheduling, or reproducibility relevant to MQ1-MQ4.
screening.full_text_rule: Missing full text for a suspected direct C1 prior-art candidate blocks the verdict and yields UNRESOLVED; it is not silently excluded.
screening.automatic_topic_gate: Exclude only records with no KGE or runtime signal in title/abstract; flag potential direct C1 records for high-priority human review without assigning a novelty verdict.

c1_verdict_precedence: Any incomplete search, unresolved conflict, or missing full text for a suspected direct candidate yields UNRESOLVED.
An exact prior with matching integration and evidence yields DROP.
An exact mechanism with a distinct audit or evidence contribution yields REFRAME.
Only strong component or weaker overlap permits RETAIN.

artifacts.pdf_policy: PDFs are not committed; the full-text manifest records path, availability, and SHA-256 when present.

determinism.raw_snapshot_rule: Given the same raw snapshot and protocol, normalization, derivation, and output serialization must be byte-identical.
determinism.ordering: Sort records by canonical dedup key, then record ID; sort CSV columns by the declared schema.

acceptance_gates: All three open indexes are queried for the frozen query set and G0/G1/G2 retrieval is complete.
All conflicts, direct candidates, and missing-full-text blockers are adjudicated.
Every C1 facet has a located full text or an explicit UNRESOLVED blocker.
Exactly one C1 verdict is emitted; C2-C4 cannot emit contribution verdicts.
Every reported value traces to a derived row and an original source record.
Derivation from one raw snapshot is byte-deterministic across two runs.
No GPU process, training run, runtime-code change, or paper-body change is required by this audit.
